note: OpenCut web (apps/web: TanStack Start + Vite, built for Cloudflare Workers). Installed and built with Bun (the repo's package manager: bunfig.toml; npm install crashes on this tree), served with vite preview, which runs the built worker locally in workerd via @cloudflare/vite-plugin. apps/api (Worker) and apps/desktop (Rust) are not browser UIs.
start: cd apps/web && exec ~/.bun/bin/bun x vite preview --port $PORT --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort
